parts.name: barrel shell

physics.Basic_description: Long orange cylindrical tube forming the main handle and battery compartment, with a smooth matte plastic finish.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the batteries and electronics, providing the primary structural body and grip surface.
physics.Grasped_description: The ideal grasp location; a parallel jaw gripper should clamp around the mid-section of the cylinder.
physics.reason: Standard injection-molded flashlight body is a thin-walled tube enclosing air and batteries.

parts.description: Long orange cylindrical tube forming the main handle and battery compartment, with a smooth matte plastic finish.
parts.function: Houses the batteries and electronics, providing the primary structural body and grip surface.

parts.name: shoulder shell

physics.Basic_description: Orange conical transition section connecting the narrower barrel to the wider head.
physics.Functional_description: Structural transition that widens the housing to accommodate the reflector and lens assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped if the barrel is obstructed, though the taper may cause slippage without sufficient friction.
physics.reason: Continuous molded shell with the barrel, enclosing empty space.

parts.description: Orange conical transition section connecting the narrower barrel to the wider head.
parts.function: Structural transition that widens the housing to accommodate the reflector and lens assembly.

parts.name: head shell

physics.Basic_description: Wide orange cylindrical section at the front containing the light source components.
physics.Functional_description: Encloses the reflector and LED, providing impact protection and heat dissipation surface area.
physics.Grasped_description: Graspable by the outer diameter, but care must be taken not to obstruct the light beam or press the lens.
physics.reason: Housing shell enclosing the optical cavity.

parts.description: Wide orange cylindrical section at the front containing the light source components.
parts.function: Encloses the reflector and LED, providing impact protection and heat dissipation surface area.

parts.name: reflector

physics.Basic_description: Internal conical surface, likely chrome-plated plastic, visible behind the lens.
physics.Functional_description: Focuses and directs the light from the LED emitter into a beam.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, not accessible for grasping without disassembly.
physics.reason: Thin-walled optical component shaped as a cone/funnel.

parts.description: Internal conical surface, likely chrome-plated plastic, visible behind the lens.
parts.function: Focuses and directs the light from the LED emitter into a beam.

parts.name: led emitter

physics.Basic_description: Tiny central component at the focal point of the reflector.
physics.Functional_description: Generates the light when electric current is applied.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to grasp; fragile electronic component.
physics.reason: Small dense semiconductor/ceramic package.

parts.description: Tiny central component at the focal point of the reflector.
parts.function: Generates the light when electric current is applied.

parts.name: lens disc

physics.Basic_description: Transparent flat or slightly convex disc covering the front aperture, appearing light blue in the render.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the internal optics from dust and moisture while allowing light transmission.
physics.Grasped_description: Should not be grasped directly to avoid smudging, scratching, or breaking the glass.
physics.reason: Solid pane of glass/plastic filling the aperture.

parts.description: Transparent flat or slightly convex disc covering the front aperture, appearing light blue in the render.

parts.name: front bezel ring

physics.Basic_description: Cyan-colored ring surrounding the lens at the very front of the flashlight.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the lens and reflector assembly within the head shell.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped by the rim, but offers less surface area than the barrel.
physics.reason: Ring-shaped retaining component, hollow center.

parts.name: head rib 0

physics.Functional_description: Provides enhanced grip friction and potentially aids in heat dissipation or impact protection.
physics.Grasped_description: Excellent grasp features; the ribs prevent the gripper fingers from slipping along the smooth surface.
physics.reason: Small protruding features are effectively solid plastic relative to their size, though part of the shell mold.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
